name: Callable Gate: Callers
description: A callable gate that admits a caller listed in callers, or one acting in a listed namespace, such as a listed user's agents. Give it callers as an operation default: store an operation {adapter: "callable:gates/callers", default: {callers: [...]}} and name that as the gate, by a/<hash> to keep the list fixed.

callers.description: The DIDs it admits, as callers or as the namespaces they act in

owner.description: The namespace the caller acts in, when it differs from caller
